name: linux-min-priority-triage-filter
description: `poll --min-priority <tier>` is the urgency triage filter (LBA-REQ-013): P0 > P1 > P2(default) > P3. The mock fixture-priority discussion has WIN messages at P0 (urgent-p0-to-linux), P1 (high-p1-to-win) and P3 (routine-p3-broadcast). With --min-priority P1 the reader must keep the P0 and P1 messages (at least that urgent) and DROP the P3 one. Proves the priority ranking is applied, and that an above-threshold message is never hidden by a lower-priority one.
